description: The widget library: the only widgets lesson content may name. Each is ordinary, tested app code under src/widgets/; content picks one by name and sets its params. src/widgets/registry.test.ts fails if this list and the app's registry differ.

line-fitter.summary: Fit y = c + mx to a few points: drag the line or use the sliders; live residuals, ‖r‖² and r·(each column); keep guesses in a table to compare.

showDots.description: Show r·(1,…,1) and r·x, which are both zero at the best fit.

table.description: Offer 'Keep this guess' and a table of kept guesses.

revealBest.description: Offer a 'Show the best line' button. Off unless the learner has already found it.

dependent-columns.summary: Two dependent columns: the line of best fits in the (c, m) plane, error level lines parallel to it, a draggable p with ‖r‖² and ‖p‖², and the circle ‖x‖ = ‖p‖.

A.description: A matrix with two columns, the second a multiple of the first.

mode.description: line: p slides along the best-fit line. free: p goes anywhere.

circle.description: Draw the circle through p centred on the origin.

revealMinNorm.description: Mark the minimum-norm point. Off until the learner has found it.

svd-geometry.summary: A 2×2 matrix as rotate, stretch, rotate: the unit circle through Vᵀ, Σ and U to an ellipse, with sliders on σ₁, σ₂ and both angles; optional rank-1 truncation (error σ₂) and the pseudo-inverse's 1/σ rule.

matrix.description: Start from this 2×2 matrix (its SVD is computed). Otherwise from sigma and the angles.

pinv.description: Show what the pseudo-inverse does to each σ.
